arguments.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Redraw Image 1 as one polished cartoon game sprite matching Image 2, which is STYLE AND CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY. The exact original pixel sprite in Image 1 controls pose, facing, proportions, framing, visible parts and occlusions. Smooth bold black ink, clean bright cel shading. Dolphin pale blue-gray with soft cream/light-gray underbelly, rounded friendly head and smiling beak. Adult mermaid has flowing yellow hair, cyan headband, peach skin and a green swimsuit top. Convert any red/white skin dithering to solid natural peach shading. A smaller distant departure view, in a very wide low silhouette. Dolphin at left faces almost toward viewer with slight right yaw, rounded forehead, cheerful eyes and smiling beak; its visible torso slopes down-left into the water. Mermaid is smaller at far right, swimming toward the right and leaning forward; hair streams left, one arm reaches left back toward dolphin and other down-right into water. Match their relative scale to Image 1, do not enlarge the mermaid to equal dolphin height. Preserve the source silhouette and body visibility: parts underwater remain absent, never complete hidden characters, no full underwater bodies, no added tails unless visible in the source. Only thin cyan-and-white water ripples where shown. All drawn parts inside the canvas with transparent margin. Actual transparent RGBA background; no checkerboard, scenery, shadow, text, collage or pixel texture.
